description: Held-out route: train on the other three routes and test on the fourth, against training on direct only and on all four. The number of training incidents is the same in every regime (subsampled, stratified), so differences are not due to more data.

notes: gap_closed = (R leave-one-out - R direct-only) / (R all-four - R direct-only) on the held-out route. A fold enters the mean only if its gap (the denominator) is at least 0.05; pooled_gap_closed is the sum of numerators over the sum of denominators across all folds. Every regime is trained on the same number of incidents (see meta).
